visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a vibrant graphic overlay titled '2025 Japan Latest Beauty News' over a shot of the PLAZA Spring Exhibition booth. The setting is a brightly lit convention hall with rows of colorful skincare products displayed on shelves and tables. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of Saborino Mega-shot mask packaging in yellow and blue. A woman's hands hold the products against a soft-lit indoor background. She then demonstrates pulling a mask from the package and applying it to her face, showing the texture and fit around the nose and jawline. (3) The scene shifts to the AHA Cleansing Research section. A hand holds a pink bottle of cleansing oil. The product is pumped onto a hand marked with makeup, and the woman massages it into her skin, showing the emulsification process. She is then seen rinsing her face at a white bathroom sink under bright artificial light. (4) Next, the Kansosan Brightening Essence is featured. The white box and bottle are held in front of a window with natural daylight. The woman applies the clear, watery essence to her hand and then taps it onto her face while looking into a mirror. (5) The Kansosan Moisture UV Essence follows, shown as a white and yellow bottle. The cream is applied to the back of a hand and smoothed out, then applied to the cheeks. The lighting remains bright and natural. (6) A yellow pack of Cucupore C nose masks is shown. The woman applies a rectangular strip to her nose and chin in a bathroom setting. (7) Finally, the video concludes with a montage of all five products on a shelf, followed by a social media information card featuring logos and handles against a pink background.

(3) [Variety]: 展內有設計遊戲關卡/展區也超好拍. (4) [Variety]: 發現很多厲害的新品!你們快收藏起來. (5) [Slogan]: Saborino. [Subtitle]: mega-shot 早安面膜 濃密版(黃) mega-shot 晚安面膜 濃密版(藍). [Slogan]: 主打1片面膜就有1罐精華液. (6) [Slogan]: AHA. [Slogan]: 去角質卸妝油. [Variety]: 這款是針對大人肌的卸妝油. [Variety]: 質地比普通卸妝油濃厚. [Variety]: 每天使用OK/有4種去角質成分 可以溫和去角質. [Variety]: 還有加入 最近非常紅的外泌體. [Variety]: 它質地很濃稠 清潔時不會拉扯到肌膚. [Variety]: 就像在用精華液卸妝. [Variety]: 同時兼具保濕力. [Variety]: 透明精華質地 吸收超讚. [Variety]: 一點點黏膩感都沒有 台灣的夏天也適合!. (8) [Slogan]: kansosan. [Slogan]: 乾燥小姐 防曬精華乳. [Variety]: 它是養膚型防曬. [Variety]: 上臉就像在擦保養品 不緊繃、不黏膩. [Variety]: 很多地方大斷貨 有看到請趕快放進購物籃. (9) [Slogan]: CUCUPORE C. [Slogan]: 毛孔調理局部面膜. [Variety]: 改善粉刺問題的鼻膜. [Variety]: 裡面有水楊酸和3重維他命C. [Variety]: 推薦給有黑頭粉刺困擾的朋友. (10) [Variety]: 哪一款 你最有興趣? 快留言告訴我. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy, upbeat synthesizer BGM with a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. A female narrator begins speaking in a bright, fast-paced Traditional Chinese delivery, introducing the Plaza exhibition. (2) A 'ding' sound effect punctuates the transition to the first product. The BGM continues as a cheerful backdrop. The narrator details the features of the Saborino masks with rising intonation to maintain excitement. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' SFX signals the change to the AHA cleansing oil. The narrator's pitch remains high and energetic. (4) As the Kansosan products are introduced, 'sparkle' SFX are used to emphasize key points. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (5) Each new product feature is highlighted by the narrator with a clear, enunciated broadcast quality, while the music maintains a rhythmic flow. (6) The video ends with a final 'ding' sound as the narrator asks for viewer engagement, followed by a quick fade-out of the BGM.
